configurations.name: static
runtimeArgs: import os, http.server, socketserver; port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', '0')); socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; httpd = socketserver.TCPServer(('', port), http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler); print('listening', httpd.server_address[1], flush=True); httpd.serve_forever()
